overview.title: Today at a glance
overview.description: Orders count purchases; deliveries count kvittlach × tziyunim — they are kept separate so nothing is double-counted. Every figure links to its source.

revenue.title: Revenue by currency
revenue.note: No currency conversion is applied: each currency is reported on its own until real exchange rates are connected.

breakdown.geoNote: Country is a hint from the order context, not verified identity.

funnel.title: Conversion funnel
funnel.body: Not measured yet. A privacy-respecting analytics provider (no request content, no third-party ad tracking) must be connected before visit-to-order conversion can be shown. We do not display estimated funnels.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Search by order reference or email. Kvittel content is never shown in lists.
orders.privacyNote: Exports and lists contain no names or requests.
orders.detailDesc: Each tziyun is a separate delivery with its own print job and attempts.

actions.uncertainHelp: Check the unit physically (or its camera, where installed) before deciding. Re-queuing prints the kvittel again.
actions.revealWarning: This kvittel may contain sensitive personal information. Access is restricted and permanently recorded with your reason.
actions.dialogHint: Explain what you verified. This is stored in the audit log.

graves.title: Tziyunim
graves.description: Create, translate and publish tziyunim. A tziyun can only be active with an approved installation permit.
graves.editorDesc: Changes go live on save when the tziyun is published. Use preview to check the public page first.

editor.aliasesHint: One per line — Hebrew, Yiddish, Latin, Cyrillic. Used for search.
editor.name: Name
editor.sourcesHint: Cite verified sources. Unsourced text should say so.
editor.reviewedHint: Only mark after a native speaker checked it.
editor.timezoneHint: e.g. Europe/Budapest — all service hours use it.
editor.locationVerifiedHint: Navigation links are shown only when verified.
editor.cutoff: Cut-off on Friday / Erev Yom Tov
editor.cutoffHint: Conservative until verified coordinates allow zmanim.
editor.saveFirst: Save the tziyun first to add photos.
editor.mediaPolicy: Only authentic photos of this tziyun with a confirmed licence and credit are shown publicly. Never use a photo of another place.
editor.noMedia: No photos. The public page shows the typographic portrait.
editor.rightsConfirm: I confirm we hold the rights and the photo shows this tziyun
editor.lowRes: Low resolution — upload at least 1200px wide for a sharp result.
editor.licenseHint: e.g. CC BY-SA 4.0, or “Own photo — all rights”
editor.uploadNote: The photo appears on the site only after a credit, a licence and the rights confirmation are all filled in. Metadata (incl. GPS) is removed on upload.

mediaErrors.invalid: Something went wrong. Please try again.
mediaErrors.invalid_file: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image up to 10 MB.
mediaErrors.decode_failed: This file could not be read as an image.
mediaErrors.credit_license_required: Fill in the credit and licence before confirming rights.
mediaErrors.storage_failed: Photo storage is not available right now. Check the storage settings (write access) and try again.

editor.honesty: Never mark a tziyun active without a working unit and a permit: the public site would sell a delivery we cannot make.

errors.active_requires_permit: A tziyun can only be active with an approved permit.
errors.name_required: A published tziyun needs at least one name.

editor.roleHint: Main: cards and home · Writing: background of the writing screen · Mobile: phone crop
editor.testIntake: Test intake: accept orders without a device
editor.testIntakeHint: For testing only. The kvittel waits in the queue and is never printed or marked delivered until a real device is assigned. Turn off before opening to customers.

pricing.title: Pricing & coupons
pricing.description: Fixed price lists per currency. Every change creates a new version; orders keep the price they were sold at.
pricing.noFx: No automatic exchange-rate conversion: each currency has its own list.
pricing.bundleHint: Applied when an order contains two or more deliveries.
pricing.addOverride: Set a price for a specific tziyun
pricing.snapshotNote: Each order stores a snapshot of the prices used at the moment of purchase.

finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Gross, provider fees, refunds and net per currency, from payment records confirmed by signed webhooks.
finance.feesNote: Demo fees are estimates (2.9% + 30). Real fees come from the payment provider’s balance transactions once connected.
finance.settlementsFuture: Partner settlements and payouts are prepared in the data model and will be enabled with the partner_settlements flag.
finance.invoicesNote: Tax invoices and receipts must be issued by a licensed invoicing provider per jurisdiction. This system does not generate tax documents.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Guests and account holders, grouped by email. No kvittel content is shown here.
customers.privacyNote: Deletion requests from signed-in users are self-service. Use anonymisation for verified requests received by email.
customers.anonymizeBody: Replaces the email in all orders, purges any stored kvittel content and deletes the account. Amounts remain for accounting. This cannot be undone.

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Site committees, local technicians and institutions. Partners only ever see their own tziyunim and never kvittel content.
partners.noContent: Partner access never includes names, requests or customer details.
partners.name: Name

content.title: Content & legal
content.description: Policy and disclosure pages in every language. Mark a translation reviewed only after legal and native review.
content.uiStringsNote: Interface texts live in versioned message catalogs (messages/[locale]/*.json) and are reviewed through code review.
content.bodyHint: Paragraphs separated by a blank line. **bold** and “- ” lists are supported.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Integrations, feature flags, roles and language readiness.

int.name: Integration
int.note: Secrets live only in environment variables, never in the database or the repository.

settings.flagsNote: Flags gate features that are built but not yet approved for production. Changes are audited.

roles.note: Partner roles are always limited to the partner’s tziyunim. Only super admins can view kvittel content, and only with a recorded reason.

loc.note: Strings identical to English count as untranslated. Additional languages are enabled through NEXT_PUBLIC_EXTRA_LOCALES only after native review.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Append-only record of sensitive actions: refunds, content access, price changes, role changes, device commands.
audit.note: The audit log never contains kvittel content.
